pages.text: $(4)$(l)Spoiler!$()$(br2)This entry gives away a puzzle solution. Turn the page only if you want to see it.
$(li)The Stone of Dimensional Ascension comes from a structure with its own puzzle (separate from the gem puzzle).

$(li)Recurrent Nightmare blocks (needed for Dynamizer and other mid-late game recipes) require completion of the Dimensional Ascension ritual to craft.$(li)Dimensional shards evaporate quickly—prioritize obtaining them early before running out, as they are critical for later tiers.
